title: Story premise ENT013: The Best Empty Frame
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (two-person rivalry). Hook: Mine is worth twice as much nothing. Takeaway/theme: Attention can make a shared scene feel valuable.
description: Two gallery attendants each claim their blank frame contains the better artwork. They move the frames to capture changing real-world scenes until one sunset crosses both frames; the pair align them into a panoramic view and put the price tags away.
